criteria.criterion: Run cargo test: planner_brief numbers every criterion with its kind, marks a listed athena.toml (and defaults.toml) as a governance file, and lists the commands the verifier may run. A revision brief contains the previous plan and the text of each finding.
criteria.evidence: These two tests passed: planner_briefs_number_criteria_flag_governance_and_list_the_verifiers_commands and a_revision_brief_quotes_the_previous_plan_and_every_finding. The first checks for "1. [content] ..." and "2. [behavior] ...", for "(a governance file: allowed because the reading lists it)" on both athena.toml and defaults.toml, and for each verifier command under "## Commands the verifier may run". The second checks that every plan field marker (approach, choice, reason, rejected option, step, risk, question, demonstration command) and both findings' summary and evidence text appear.

criteria.criterion: Run cargo test: critic_brief contains every demonstration and each Athena finding. Assertions on absence show it has no planner cost and no planner command list.
criteria.evidence: critic_briefs_carry_the_demonstrations_and_athenas_findings_and_no_planner_cost_or_commands passed. It checks that every demonstration's method, command and observes text, its fails_without text, and the Athena finding's summary and evidence are present. It checks on the lowercased brief that 'cost', 'usd', '$', 'commands bash may run', 'commands the verifier may run' and 'planner_usd' are absent. CriticInputs has no field for cost or commands.

criteria.criterion: Run cargo test: the planner and critic output schemas each reject an extra property at the top level and inside a nested item (additionalProperties false at every level). The critic verdict accepts exactly accept, revise and reject.
criteria.evidence: These three tests passed: the_plan_and_critic_schemas_forbid_extra_properties_at_every_level (it walks every object schema, 6 for the plan and 2 for the critic, and asserts additionalProperties false and every field required), the_plan_and_critic_outputs_reject_an_extra_property_at_the_top_and_in_a_nested_item (top level, each list item, and decisions[].rejected[]), and the_critic_verdict_is_exactly_accept_revise_or_reject (the enum equals [accept, revise, reject]; 'pass', 'fail', 'Accept', 'approve' and '' are rejected).

criteria.criterion: Run cargo test: render_plan_section returns identical bytes for the same record called twice, under the heading 'Job plan (accepted, round r)'. verifier_brief with a plan contains the demonstrations and the planned file list but not the plan's approach, decision reasons or rejected options. With no plan its output equals a stored copy of today's output byte for byte.
criteria.evidence: These three tests passed: render_plan_section_is_deterministic_and_headed_with_the_round (two calls are equal, the output starts with '## Job plan (accepted, round 2)', and rounds 2 and 3 differ), a_verifier_brief_with_a_plan_holds_demonstrations_and_files_but_not_the_reasoning (demonstration lines and file paths present; APPROACH, CHOICE, REASON, REJECTED, STEP, RISK, QUESTION and PURPOSE markers absent), and a_verifier_brief_without_a_plan_is_byte_identical_to_the_stored_copy (both verifier_brief and verifier_brief_with_plan(None) equal an inline constant). findings.summary: verifier_brief did not itself gain an optional plan input. A sibling function, verifier_brief_with_plan, and VerifierInputs::names_with_plan were added instead.
findings.evidence: The request says "verifier_brief gains an optional plan input" and design section 4 says "VerifierInputs::names gains a conditional entry". The candidate keeps verifier_brief(inputs, inline_diff) and delegates to verifier_brief_with_plan(inputs, None, inline_diff). It behaves the same and needs no change from callers (which is why cap-change and cap-study were left untouched), but job 3 will have to call the _with_plan variants rather than the names the design uses.

findings.summary: The stored copy of today's verifier output cannot be traced to the base commit from the snapshot.
findings.evidence: The constant is described as captured before the change. The diff shows the body of verifier_brief is unchanged apart from the guarded plan insertion, so the claim holds by reading the code. I did not run it against the base commit.

summary: The candidate passes. It adds the planner and critic prompts, registered as PromptAssets, and strict PlanOutput and CriticOutput schemas that deny extra fields at every level, with the verdict limited to accept, revise and reject. It also adds planner_brief, critic_brief, render_plan_section, and a plan-aware verifier brief that carries only the demonstrations and planned file paths (F5). Nothing calls any of it yet, and run.rs, status display and athena.toml are untouched. I ran the athena-context tests (45 passed, including 9 new tests), the budgets test, the xtask tests including the boundary scanner, cargo fmt --check, clippy with -D warnings and the full workspace suite: all passed. Every acceptance criterion is met. One minor deviation: rather than adding a parameter to verifier_brief and names(), the change adds sibling functions verifier_brief_with_plan and names_with_plan. They behave the same, but they are not the names the design uses.
